searchText: devnet-7 doesn't look healthy.. It lost finality about 2h ago and participation rate dropped to ~28% on my side. Expected due to changes or incident? <@412614104222531604> any idea what's up? nodes are out of storage due to blob sizes we didn't plan in 50GB for blob storage for most nodes. we either need to do some checkpoint syncing and nuking the dir, or just shut down devnet 7 altogether https://grafana.observability.ethpandaops.io/d/participation_rates_dashboard/validator-participation-rates-dashboards?orgId=1&var-network=4844-devnet-7 All lighthouse nodes are out of storage now. I'm voting in favor to shut down devnet-7 for now. As the branches are super stale at this point. And lets prep to launch devnet-8.
